messages:
mina: Follow-up from the PM: recurring late-night noise still coming from 3 families (proxy-connections, scheduler-spike, cache-throttle). We need compact owners + quick, testable mitigations. Can @oncall-bot post 72h counts?

oncall-bot: 72h counts: proxy-connections=55, scheduler-spike=41, cache-throttle=23. Top services: inference-proxy, batch-scheduler, cache. Snapshot: https://redwood.internal/alerts/1769999998

oliver: I'll take proxy-connections. Quick plan: 1) add connect jitter, 2) bump upstream pool + circuit backoff, 3) change pager rule to require avg_conn_latency>200ms. Will open infra PR by Tue.

priya: I'll own scheduler-spike. Short fixes: cap prefetch to 800, switch alert to p95(backlog,5m) and add correlation suppression when label `ingest_burst=true`. Lab PR Wed.

quinn: taking cache-throttle. Plan: add hot-key histogram, exact-key dedupe window=12m, and tag alerts with `owner=quinn`. PR Wed EOD.

mina: two constraints: keep dedupe windows <=15m and require 72h monitoring after rollouts. Also every PR must include a one-line smoke that oncall can run.

oliver: smoke example for proxy: ```bash
# emit 3 fake connections with same header
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -H "X-Test-Key: dedupe-proxy" https://proxy-canary/ping; done
# expect: 1 pager within 15m
```

priya: scheduler smoke will fire synthetic batch bursts and check p95(backlog,5m) on dashboard. I'll add CI harness entry.

quinn: cache smoke: fire 3 identical cache-gets for hot-key -> expect 1 alert within 12m. I'll wire into CI smoke job.

mina: I'll open a tracking ticket RI-11002 and set daily status pings for the 72h windows. Please post one-line status daily like: "oliver: proxy canary OK | priya: scheduler PR open | quinn: cache PR merged"

oncall-bot: Tracking ticket created: https://redwood.internal/pm/RI-11002. Reminder set: daily check-in 09:00 UTC until 1769999998 + 72h (1770259198).

oliver: question  dedupe 12m vs 15m for cache? leaning 12m to avoid masking bursts.

quinn: 12m OK for exact-key; keep 15m for connection dedupe. Documenting both in the runbook.

priya: adding rollback guard: if suppressed_alerts > 4% AND error_rate increases >2x, auto rollback canary. I'll add this to PR checks.

mina: please include links to dashboard panels and CI smoke in PR descriptions. Let's reconvene if noise doesn't drop after 72h. Thanks all.

(1769999998 thread locked)
